notes: Browser-only app (GitHub Pages / Vercel, no Electron, no server, no Android): the updaters, window-frame, editions, android-shell and release-pipeline modules do not apply. Only the themes package is used: package.json pins turbothemes to the engine commit above (path:/themes). The appearance module's files are Curator's (Layout.tsx, layouts.css, appearance.ts); this app has its own, smaller glue in src/lib/themes.ts and src/components/budget/AppearanceCard.tsx, so engine-diff would only report 'missing' for it on purpose.
